Bert, who was a life-long friend of the late Harry Parker, first took an interest in cross-country running with the Borough Polytechnic Harriers; later joining Ashcombe A.C. and our Club of which he was a Vice- President.

As first Belgravian in that National, Gerry received the 'H. Parker Memorial Bowl' and our other runners will have a tough fight to keep his name off it for the next few seasons as well - perhaps that is why we are going to win in 1965.
It was on a Saturday in the Autumn of 1945 that Harry Parker and a group of Belgravians congregated on the Common just opposite Lauriston Road.
This event was held at Weybridge and our scoring team was:- HARRY PARKER 15, OSCAR HORWOOD 16, DICK BEST 17, and ERNIE MUSSELBROOK 18 - five seconds covering the four runners.
Amongst his colleagues were other legendary names such as Oscar Horwood, Harry Parker, Bob Ricketts, Frank Thomson, Jock McKay and Wally Bayliss.
